# Shadowrun FPS

> Community hub for Shadowrun FPS — the 2007 multiplayer first-person shooter developed by FASA Studios for Xbox 360 and PC. This site provides a free PC launcher, installation guides, troubleshooting documentation, and community events.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/): Community hub with download links and broadcast content
- [Download](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/download): Free community launcher for Windows 10+, VirusTotal-verified
- [Install Guide](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/docs/install): Step-by-step installation walkthrough (GFWL, DXVK, AntHill LIVE)
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/docs/troubleshoot): Fixes for GFWL activation, FPS limits, NAT, and controller issues
- [Events](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/docs/events): Community tournaments and scheduled matches

## About the game

Shadowrun FPS (2007) is a cross-platform multiplayer shooter that blends cyberpunk and fantasy settings. Players choose between humans and shadowrunners who can use magic abilities and technology augmentations. The game supports asymmetric team-based play and was notable for early Xbox 360 / Windows Vista cross-platform multiplayer.
